title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: only a dormant account is reactivated, and only on an established date
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to reactivation of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account on the strength of a transfer the owner makes in the contact. It states how the account's status and the transfer's date combine.

## Policy clause

1. An account that is not dormant is not reactivated.
2. For a dormant account, the reactivation date is the posted date of the owner's transfer only when every condition this policy sets for that date holds. When any of them fails, no reactivation date is established under this policy.

## Truth table

| Account dormant | Every condition for the date holds | Under this policy |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | reactivation date established: the transfer's posted date |
| yes | no | no reactivation date established |
| no (active, applied or closed) | any | not reactivated |

## Points of judgement

**The account is already active and the owner makes a telephone transfer. Is it reactivated?** No; an account that is not dormant is not reactivated. The transfer is simply a withdrawal on an active account.

**Wrong reading:** "Any dormant account with a recent transfer out is reactivated on that transfer's date." **Correct basis:** the date counts only when every condition this policy sets for it holds.
